name: claude-context-bar
description: Real-time context window usage monitor for Claude Code sessions. See token counts in your status bar with color-coded warnings.

enumDescriptions: Show the Claude Code session title (from /rename or the generated summary)
claudeContextBar.label.description: What to show as the status bar name. Hover always includes the session title when Claude Code has written one.

claudeContextBar.compactMode.markdownDescription: Shorten project names to save status bar space. Multi-word names become acronyms (`my-cool-project` → `MCP`), single words become abbreviated (`typescript` → `Tscript`). Names ≤5 chars stay unchanged. Only applies when `#claudeContextBar.label#` is `project`.

claudeContextBar.shortNames.markdownDescription: Custom short names for projects. Keys are project names, values are the short versions, e.g. `{"my-cool-project": "MCP", "webapp": "WA"}`. Only applies when `#claudeContextBar.label#` is `project`.

claudeContextBar.showEmoji.description: Show emoji icons based on project name (music 🎵, code 💻, game 🎮, etc.)

claudeContextBar.autoColor.description: Automatically assign different colors to each project (rainbow). When off, uses your base color with subtle variations.

claudeContextBar.baseColor.markdownDescription: Base color when `#claudeContextBar.autoColor#` is off. Each project gets a subtle variation of this color.

claudeContextBar.contextLimit.description: Fallback context window size in tokens, used only for unknown or non-Claude model IDs. Current Claude models are auto-detected (1M by default, 200K for Haiku and legacy models).

claudeContextBar.modelContextLimits.markdownDescription: Per-model context limit overrides (Model ID → token limit). Exact match only, no glob or prefix matching, e.g. `{"claude-haiku-4-5": 500000}`. Highest priority: overrides auto-detection and `#claudeContextBar.contextLimit#` for that exact model.

claudeContextBar.warningTokens.markdownDescription: Tokens consumed at which to show warning color (yellow). An absolute token count, not a percentage, so it means the same thing on a 200K and a 1M model. Set `0` to disable the warning color. Should be lower than `#claudeContextBar.dangerTokens#`.

claudeContextBar.dangerTokens.markdownDescription: Tokens consumed at which to show danger color (red). An absolute token count, not a percentage. Set `0` to disable the danger color. Should be higher than `#claudeContextBar.warningTokens#`; if it is not, only the danger color appears.

claudeContextBar.showUsage.markdownDescription: Show your Claude subscription usage (the 5-hour session limit from `/usage`) as a separate item to the right of the context items. Opt-in: reads the Claude Code OAuth token and calls an undocumented Anthropic endpoint, which may stop working at any time. Requires being signed in to Claude Code with a subscription.

claudeContextBar.usageWarningThreshold.description: Usage percentage at which to show warning color (yellow) on the usage item

claudeContextBar.usageDangerThreshold.description: Usage percentage at which to show danger color (red) on the usage item

claudeContextBar.usageRefreshInterval.markdownDescription: How often (in seconds) to refresh subscription usage from the `/usage` endpoint. The endpoint rate-limits aggressive polling, so avoid very low values.

claudeContextBar.refreshInterval.description: How often (in seconds) to refresh context usage from Claude Code session files

claudeContextBar.idleTimeout.description: Seconds of inactivity before hiding a session (default: 180 / 3 minutes). Set 0 to never hide idle sessions. Click to manually hide.

claudeContextBar.configDir.description: Claude Code config directory — the folder that contains projects/, not projects/ itself. Leave empty to use the CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR environment variable, then ~/.claude. Set this if VS Code does not inherit your shell environment (common when launched from the Start Menu or Finder).

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run clean && npm run compile
